changes: Fix: Strict filtering of non-model files (images, audio, text) at API and Matcher level
Fix: Prevent searcher from processing invalid file extensions
Fix: Critical bug where official model map was ignored (Duplicate method)
Improvement: Increased fuzzy matching threshold to 0.75 to avoid false positives (e.g. Art vs Non-Art)
Feature: Added support for Wan 2.1 and Z-Image-Turbo official mapping
Fix: Resolved issue where non-model files (images, text) were incorrectly matched
Fix: Fixed local model index not updating when files are moved or renamed (path tracking)
Improvement: Enhanced robustness of file monitoring events
Feature: Provider priority reordering (Civitai > HuggingFace > Liblib > ModelScope > Google)
Feature: Added LiblibProvider for liblib.art native search
Feature: Chinese Core Extraction for better international platform matching
Feature: Non-model file filtering in scanner (VALID_MODEL_EXTENSIONS)
Improvement: Full Chinese filename as primary search term (with English fallback) for better accuracy on localized platforms
Feature: Deep Tokenization for complex filenames (e.g., 'wan22Remix' -> 'wan 22 Remix')
Feature: Progressive Search Strategy (Raw Stem -> Spaced -> Deep Token)
Feature: Added DuckDuckGo (HTML) as robust fallback provider
Fix: HuggingFace URL parsing for gated/deep repo paths
Fix: GGUF keyword preservation for accurate quantized model matching
UI: Removed redundant version number from Settings dialog
Performance: Optimized search concurrency and scoring logic
